title: Rough Alchemy Cauldron
text: An open crystal vessel holding 4 B of one fluid. Use buckets or fluid containers to fill and empty it. Insert items by right-clicking, up to four types with one stack each; use an empty hand to retrieve them.
Items float on fluid or rest at the bottom when dry. Breaking the vessel drops items but loses fluid. Use it on a campfire to form a Primitive Reaction Cauldron.
